title: Normalized finite realization and scalar Tate comparisons
statement: Fix the unshifted Tate complexes [def-pur-canonical-tate-complex-comparisons] and their completed comparisons [def-pur-canonical-tate-completed-comparisons]. The finite ordinary pullback has a unique comparison with intrinsic realization normalized on the actual adjunction unit. Completed integral scalar extension of a Tate line along a finite coefficient extension is uniquely normalized by its completion map and ordinary scalar/root line map. Finite quotient scalar extension is uniquely normalized on pure root tensors. Integral-to-finite reduction on the flat single line has invertible derived counit and the specified signed root-line reduction comparison. Define the rational pullback/product and the finite, integral and rational square conjugations from these maps, without changing their representative choices.

source.place: Canonical roots-of-unity Tate factors and their tensor, coefficient and pullback comparisons in the source-of-purity composite.

proof.text: For finiteRealization_existsUnique, specialize openSquarePullbackModel_existsUnique to the coefficient quotient at exponent n+1. Its ordinary pullback and actual adjunction unit are definitionally the finiteModulePull and finiteModuleSection in this module; it supplies the displayed section normalization and uniqueness.

For integralScalarLine_existsUnique, invert the canonical scalarCompletionIso on the complete integral twisting object, then compose the ordinary exact-functor single comparison with single(twistLineScalarIso). Cancellation of the invertible completion map proves both the required equation and uniqueness.
For integralReductionCounit_isIso, specialize the K-flat counit clause of scalarReductionDerivedExistence to the existing integralGood single-complex theorem.

Use the existing completed and ordinary line comparisons to define the finite and rational pullback/product maps and their square conjugations. The finiteScalarSheaf_existsUnique statement remains its original named hole, with its source and full scalar/root proof description retained. All scalar and realization declarations are relocated verbatim.

proof_origin.place: E9: original comparison declarations grouped into a separate module after local definition-opacity and shared-completeness optimizations still left the original file over 60 seconds. No statement, data construction, or mathematical hole added.

theorem integralScalarLine_existsUnique
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra (Padic l) L] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) L]
    (ι : E →ₐ[Padic l] L) (X : Scheme.{u})
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)] (r : ℕ) :
    ∃! e : (integralScalarExtension l E L ι X).obj
        (sfIntegralTwistingObject l E X (r : ℤ)) ≅
      sfIntegralTwistingObject l L X (r : ℤ),
      (scalarCompletion l E L ι X).app (sfIntegralTwistingObject l E X (r : ℤ)) ≫
        e.hom =
      ((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι X).mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).hom.app
        (integralTwistLine l E X (r : ℤ)) ≫
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).map (twistLineScalarIso l E X L ι (r : ℤ)).hom
